global_recent.meaning: Worldwide observations, no worldwide harmonized baseline. Global tiles extend to ±86° latitude; missing detections do not establish no fire.

protocol.prior_information: The original Indonesia, India and Australia results have already been inspected. This global expansion is exploratory, not a blind external validation study.
protocol.spatial_grid: EPSG:6933, occupied 1 km cell per UTC day; 0.5-degree display bins
protocol.primary_policy: Use Aqua 2003-2025 if support is insufficient or agreement checks fail. Otherwise use Aqua through 2021 and adjusted NOAA-20 from 2022. Publish every candidate and its failures separately.
protocol.interpretation: Predeclared prototype screening thresholds, not agency standards, statistical confidence bounds, operational certification or validation against all ground fires. Passing nationally does not validate small selected regions. Observation completeness and NRT transfer remain unresolved.

coverage_note: 185 eligible NASA country/territory archive labels; this is not every jurisdiction or every land pixel. National coefficients are not globally interchangeable. No summed global anomaly is inferred.
